name: Off-Hand Partner Hook Pass
setup: Face a partner about 4 metres away, ball at the chest.
cues: Same drill with the ball in your less-used hand: slow and clean beats fast and messy.
Shoulder to the cone, swing the ball high over the top to the partner.
Step toward the target as the ball leaves.

faults.fix: Step and snap the ball so it arrives on a line.

faults.fault: Passing where the partner was, not going
faults.fix: Lead the partner: throw to the space they are moving into.
